notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Is live!
notes.content:
Hello there Space Pilots!
This is another tiny patch that addresses the performance issue inside of the space ship

[olist]
[*] Improve the optimization while inside of the spaceship (optimizing light and smarter background objects rendering)
[*] Fixed a bug where the music won't start on the first level
[/olist]


Please let me know if it improve things for you

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Is live!
notes.content:
Hello there Space Pilots!
This is a tiny patch with two most common complaints:

[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy Slug Ships will have infinite range
[*] Fixed a bug where the conversation dialogs will not be in the right localization language
[/olist]

Please let me know if you find more things and if you still have localization issues!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Is live!
notes.content:
Hello there Space Pilots!
On this patch I made a change to help with the frustration of not having a checkpoint system during levels (Its a huge challenge at this point)

I decided to add 9 lives for our space cats so you could respawn right away if something went wrong with one of your battles!

Also added some quality of life improvements that were requested through feedback and reviews

[olist]
[*] New Feature: Added the ability to respawn using one of your nine lives instead of restarting a level
[*] Quality Of Life: Added an option in the option menu to stop focusing player on new turn
[*] Quality Of Life: Added an option in the option menu to stop focusing on enemy ships between turns
[/olist]

Please let me know if it improve things!
More things will come in the future!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Is live!
notes.content:
Hello there Space Pilots!
On this patch I tried to do some optimizations to allow higher FPS when going inside the players ship!

[olist]
[*] Optimization - Hide space stations when zooming into ship (except for when shopping)
[*] Optimization - Hide ships when going inside player ship
[/olist]

Please let me know if it improve things!
I will keep trying to add more optimizations as soon as I can

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Is live!
notes.content:
Hello there Space Pilots!
The first ever patch of Space Cats Tactics is live now!
I have been solving the following issues:

[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where HUD could disappear on the inventory and equipment tutorial on Level1
[*] Fixed an issue where player can get blocked on level2 and it would be impossible to complete
[*] Removed confusing green target icons from secret cache when collected
[*] Level4 caravan encounter made easier by moving trigger area further away from the enemies, giving more time to the player deal with it in advance
[*] Fixed a case where a story tech on the tech tree wouldn't be unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue with some achievements given for free when finishing a level
[*] Fixed an issue where a player could use upgrade on shop view without buying them
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera will focus on enemy ship instead of its target AOE blast zone
[*] Fix and issue where warp in sound effect would ignore the effect mixer
[*] Fixed an issue where items from previous levels will not be sold on later shops
[*] Fixed and issue that can cause Amir and Lizzy's ship to stay too long on level7
[/olist]
